message.ja: local component実行，複数sourceを結合するMNL推定，CSV／Parquet変換，宣言的joinとRun接続，desktop prototype，componentのinstallと公式registry取得を追加しました．
message.en: Davis adds local component execution, multi-source MNL data binding, CSV and Parquet transformation, declarative joins and run chaining, a desktop prototype, component installation, and official registry retrieval.
